title: All Cape Boat Rentals
specs: Explore the Inner Hyannis Harbor, tie up for Fish and Chips at Baxter's Boathouse then make your way out to Lewis Bay, drop anchor and take a swim off Egg Island, a sandbar that appears for 3 hours on each side of low tide.
You can reach us at 508 827 2001 Please be prepared to sign a waiver at check in Photo ID will be required.
The registered renter and driver of the boat must be at least 25 years of age.
Cancellations must be made 7 days in advance of rental period for refund.

Start by exploring the Inner Hyannis Harbor, tie up for Fish and Chips at Baxter's Boathouse then make your way out to Lewis Bay, drop anchor and take a swim off Egg Island, a sandbar that appears for 3 hours on each side of low tide.
Children 12 and under are required by state law to wear a life jacket at all times aboard the vessel.

quotes.text: My family and I were impressed with you and your staff from our first contact on your website, our subsequent phone conversation, your advice and help getting me familiar with the boat, the area, and advice on the best itinerary! Quality and safe equipment and quality, knowledgeable and friendly people.

Thunderstorms interfered with what would have been a longer ride, but Emma at kept us posted with weather alerts by cell phone, and gave us the all-clear when the storm cleared. The boat was seaworthy, in very good shape, gas included in the rental, reasonably priced, and we had a terrific time.

Great communication with Jake prior to coming to Cape Cod and he made us feel welcome when we arrived. We rented a 22' speedboat for tubing. My children had a blast!! The boat was clean and fast. The surrounding area was amazing. We truly would recommend All Cape Boat Rental.

The team here at All Cape Boat Rentals really nailed it. When I say "team" I really do mean team, too. They have a great staff of mainly Maritime educated individuals that enjoy their job and want you to enjoy your time on the water.
